# File Combiner

> A free, privacy-first browser app for combining selected code files, documentation, and configuration into one AI-ready Markdown, XML, or plain-text context file.

## Product summary

File Combiner runs locally in the browser. It has no account requirement and no server-side code-upload flow. Users can select a folder or individual files, exclude noise such as dependencies and build output, choose relevant files, inspect an estimated token budget, then copy or download a combined result.

## Core capabilities

- Folder selection, multi-file selection, and nested folder drag-and-drop in supported browsers
- Standard, Minimal, None, and Aggressive exclusion presets
- Custom glob-style exclusion patterns
- Search, language filters, file sorting, and paste-path selection
- Markdown, XML, and plain-text output
- Optional folder tree, safe whitespace compaction, prompt templates, project brief, token estimates
- Optional likely-secret redaction in generated output
- Local browser processing; selected file contents are not uploaded by the app

## Safety notes

The standard preset excludes common environment and private-key file names. The likely-secret redaction feature is an additional safeguard, not a guarantee. Users should review the final output before sharing it with any third-party AI provider or service.
